'''Iwo Białynicki-Birula''' (born 14 June 1933 in [[Warsaw]]<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://encyklopedia.pwn.pl/haslo/Bialynicki-Birula-Iwo;3877121.html|title=Białynicki-Birula Iwo, Encyklopedia PWN: źródło wiarygodnej i rzetelnej wiedzy|website=encyklopedia.pwn.pl}}</ref>) is a Polish theoretical physicist. He works as a professor at the Center for Theoretical Physics, [[Polish Academy of Sciences]], an institution that he initiated in 1980.<ref>{{Cite web |title=General Information – CFT PAN |url=https://www.cft.edu.pl/en/about-us/ |access-date=2025-09-28 |website=www.cft.edu.pl}}</ref> He is also a [[professor emeritus]] at the Faculty of Physics, [[University of Warsaw]].<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.fuw.edu.pl/profesorowie-emerytowani.html?show=2822|title=Profesorowie emerytowani - Wydział Fizyki Uniwersytetu Warszawskiego|website=www.fuw.edu.pl}}</ref> He holds a [[Professor|full professorship]] in [[physical sciences|physics]].<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://symposium-bialynicki-birula.cft.edu.pl/|title=90-th BIRTHDAY OF PROF. IWO BIAŁYNICKI-BIRULA|website=symposium-bialynicki-birula.cft.edu.pl}}</ref>

He received the [[Prize of the Foundation for Polish Science]] in mathematical, physical and engineering sciences in 2014<ref>https://fnp.org.pl/en/component/fnp_programs/program/the-fnp-prize</ref> and the [[Marian Smoluchowski Medal|Smoluchowski Medal]]<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.ptf.net.pl/index.php/node/85|title=Medal Mariana Smoluchowskiego &#124; Polskie Towarzystwo Fizyczne|website=www.ptf.net.pl}}</ref> of the [[Polish Physical Society]] in 2021. In 2023 for his overall lifetime fundamental contributions to the Quantum Mechanics, especially for constructing the counterexample to the Feynman theorem  about the [[Gauge theory|gauge invariance]] of the unrenormalized transition amplitudes generated by his [[Feynman diagram|diagrams]], construction of the [[Gausson (physics)|nonlinear quantum mechanics]] and for the discovery of the [[Trojan wave packet|Trojan Wave Packets]] he was granted the [[Wigner Medal]] awarded for the first time ever outside the strict [[Group theory|Group Theory]].<ref>{{cite book | last1=Wiley-Bohm | first1=Darlene | last2=Kielanowski | first2=Piotr | last3=Schleich | first3=Wolfgang P. | title=Geometric Methods in Physics XL | chapter=Wigner Medal 2023 | series=Trends in Mathematics | date=2024 | pages=9–15 | doi=10.1007/978-3-031-62407-0_2 | isbn=978-3-031-62406-3 | chapter-url=https://link.springer.com/chapter/10.1007/978-3-031-62407-0_2 }}</ref> He is a full member of the [[Polish Academy of Sciences]].<ref>{{Cite web |title=Iwo Białynicki-Birula {{!}} Polska Akademia Nauk |url=https://pan.pl/czlonkowie/iwo-bialynicki-birula/ |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20250704034253/https://pan.pl/czlonkowie/iwo-bialynicki-birula/ |archive-date=2025-07-04 |access-date=2025-09-28 |website=pan.pl |language=pl-PL}}</ref>

He published multiple works on field theory, [[quantum electrodynamics]] and [[renormalization]] theory.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://scholar.google.com/citations?user=zvGZpNoAAAAJ&hl=en|title=Iwo Bialynicki-Birula|website=scholar.google.com}}</ref>
